# Language branches (#936): lines that pick a text by the output language (`if en`, `if !en`,
# `if is_english(..)`, `if locale == "en"`, `match en`, `match (.., en)`), per file, test code excluded.
# The texts belong in `locales/<lang>/*.ftl`, one message per text; Rust decides which applies.
# The baseline may only shrink: lower a count when a file loses branches, drop the line at zero.
# `UPDATE_LANGUAGE_BRANCHES=1 cargo test --test architecture_test` rewrites it downwards.
#
# What the remaining lines are (state at the close of #936). Only the ratchet is binding; this
# list explains why a line is still here, so nobody has to rediscover it.
#
# 1. Experimental indicators (src/ai_visibility, src/page_flow, src/source_quality, src/ux,
#    src/commerce, src/content_visibility, output/builder/single/module_details/commerce.rs):
#    parked until the calibration decision #891 (#916); moved text by text once they stay.
# 2. Texts owned by a data table of another module, which carries one title per language
#    (`wcag::en301549`, `wcag::bik_guide`, `wcag::coverage`): output/pdf/en301549.rs, bik_guide.rs,
#    wcag_coverage.rs, batch_report/overview.rs, batch_report/consistency.rs. The table has to
#    become Fluent first; the branch only picks the field.
# 3. Barrierlab boundary (CLAUDE.md "Boundary to barrierlab"), fixed there, not here:
#    wcag/shared.rs, html_conform/message.rs, seo/robots.rs, performance/render_blocking.rs.
# 4. Number notation, not text (EN "4,200" / "0.5", DE "4.200" / "0,5"): i18n/number.rs,
#    output/pdf/findings.rs, output/pdf/detail_modules/performance.rs,
#    module_details/performance.rs, audit/performance_interpretation.rs.
# 5. Choosing between two texts that already exist (stored canonical English or re-derived,
#    `LocalizedText::for_locale`, `Severity::label`/`label_en`, the band table in
#    registry/bands.rs) or binding the locale flag once and passing it on: audit/interpretation.rs,
#    audit/finding_contract.rs, audit/normalized.rs, output/builder/{actions,batch,modules}.rs,
#    builder/single/{mod,diagnosis}.rs, module_details/{experience,seo}.rs, output/terminal.rs,
#    registry/bands.rs. `registry/bands.rs` is a public table and needs its own slice.
